title: Epr
description: Complete EPR atom: envelope header + raw payload bytes. Source of truth: EPR atom, self-notarized via content-address (CIDv1 dag-cbor sha256) + Ed25519 signature. Canonical CBOR bytes + detached signature is the authoritative form. Category A — notarized; notarization mechanism is content-derived CID + signer proof (not DHT). JSON wire format: payload serializes as an integer array (byte array produced by serde_bytes on Vec<u8>).

payload.description: Raw payload bytes serialized as an integer array by serde_bytes. Interpretation is determined by the schemaRef + schemaKey in the envelope.
